seriesTitle: Tougen Anki: Dark Demon of Paradise

episodes.title: Oni's Blood
episodes.summary: Teenager Shiki is attacked by a mysterious man. As his foster father Tsuyoshi helps him flee, he learns of his surprising and legendary heritage.

episodes.title: If You Want to Make It, Keep On Winning
episodes.summary: Shiki awakes to find himself before Oni Agency member Naito Mudano, who evaluates Shiki's potential as a valuable addition to the organization.

episodes.title: Blood Eclipse Release
episodes.summary: Mudano splits the new students into teams before the strange game of tag begins, but Shiki soon gets into a fight with his teammate Jin Kougasaki.

episodes.title: Work With Me
episodes.summary: Shiki collapses after overexerting himself during his fight with the titan. Unconcerned about his teammates, Kougasaki attempts to take down Mudano.

episodes.title: Bad News
episodes.summary: Mudano takes Shiki and the others to the Oni Agency's Kyoto base. But a sinister plot to disturb their hidden sanctuary is already quietly underway.

episodes.title: Even the Loner Path Has Its Limits
episodes.summary: Forced to fight their reanimated fallen comrades, the Support Unit members find themselves overwhelmed, putting the Kyoto Base at serious risk.

episodes.title: The Beauty is a Beast
episodes.summary: After Tsubakiri launches a surprise attack, Oiranzaka attempts to buy time for the others to find a way to escape from Yomogi's black bacteria trap.

episodes.title: The Unreliable Hero
episodes.summary: Despite Sazanami's confidence, one of the Uglies quickly overpowers her. The terrified Kiriyama feels helpless as he watches from his hiding place.

episodes.title: Momotaro Spirit
episodes.summary: Tsubakiri opens a coffin, out of which steps the reanimated corpse of a Momotaro agent who Tsubakiri claims chose to become his puppet.

episodes.title: Children of Kishin
episodes.summary: Samidare visits the Momotaro headquarters in Tokyo. Brushing off fellow agent Shinya's provocations, he declares he will be the one to kill Shiki.

episodes.title: Thank You!
episodes.summary: Overwhelmed by Shiki's intense flames, a wounded Tsubakiri recalls the promise he made to his mentor, Manaka — the man whose corpse he controls.

episodes.title: Day of the Storm
episodes.summary: On a stormy night when the students are unwinding in the baths after training, Mudano orders them to assemble in the gym for an evacuation drill.

episodes.title: Mikado, Like Gate of the Gods
episodes.summary: Mudano and the others arrive in Tokyo to observe the Oni Agency units. Shiki visits a local festival, where he hits it off with a cop named Mikado.

episodes.title: Personal Rule
episodes.summary: When Kougasaki uses his blood technique in public, the Momotaro agents detect it and move to capture him. Mudano takes the students to an Oni hideout.

episodes.title: Found You
episodes.summary: Shinya is looking for the academy students to carry out the plan he has in mind.

episodes.title: Not Bad
episodes.summary: A kidnapping, a hostage, and a secret plan intertwine in an attempt to find Shiki's whereabouts.

episodes.title: The Vengeful Oni
episodes.summary: Jin reminisces about everything he experienced during his childhood.

episodes.title: Haunted by Doubt
episodes.summary: The squadrons are set in motion as doubts creep in about what's coming.

episodes.title: The Voice of the Weak
episodes.summary: Mikado meets Shiki and reveals who he is, but Shiki doesn't know why he knows his name or what he's plotting.

episodes.title: Flawless Fortune
episodes.summary: The tarot cards and their position can tip the balance of the fight one way or the other.

episodes.title: A Futile Battle
episodes.summary: During the battle, Shinya remembers his past and what motivated him to aspire to get where he is today.

episodes.title: My Friend
episodes.summary: After awakening as an Oni, Shiki Ichinose must master his power and join the age-old war against the Momotaro.

episodes.title: Until We Meet Again
episodes.summary: After the battle, everyone must re-evaluate their destiny and the next steps that need to be taken.
